# netactuate_ddos_rule (Data Source)

Reads a DDoS Rule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_ddos_rule" "example" {
  rule_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `rule_id` (Number) DDoS mitigation rule ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `rules` (List of Object) DDoS mitigation rule returned by the API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
